C0283.title: Wenzhou Technology Company Fined RMB 1 Million for Failing Data Security Obligations
C0283.summary: In March 2023, Wenzhou cyber police in Zhejiang investigated a data security violation. A technology company developing and operating an information management system for a county-level government department uploaded sensitive business data to a public cloud without authorization or safeguards, causing a serious data breach. The company, project supervisor, and directly responsible person were fined RMB 1 million, RMB 80,000, and RMB 60,000 respectively.
